name: causalgraph-hero-film
description: Renders the landing page's product film: a replica of the contract review desk driven by a timeline, drawn frame by frame in headless Chromium and encoded with ffmpeg.

scripts.render: for lang in zh en; do for mode in landscape portrait; do node render_film.mjs --lang $lang --mode $mode --out out/$lang-$mode.mkv; done; done
